added_models.model: Tufted capuchin monkeys (low uricase, high plasma urate) dosed with UR-1102/epaminurad

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract read (PMID 26907620). Year 2013 is a proxy: the monkey work preceded the first phase 1 (NCT01953497, posted 2013-10-01). UR-1102 is epaminurad (URC102): the phase 2b paper cites Ahn 2016 as epaminurad's in vivo study.
engagement.quote: When compared with the same dosage of benzbromarone, UR-1102 showed a better pharmacokinetic profile, increased the fractional excretion of urinary uric acid, and reduced plasma uric acid more effectively.
engagement.note: Epaminurad (UR-1102) raised urinary urate fractional excretion and lowered plasma urate in low-uricase capuchin monkeys before human dosing.
engagement.short: Monkey FEUA up, plasma urate down

engagement.magnitude_basis: direction of sUA and FEUA change
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract read (PMID 31056705); epub month not confirmed, print Nov 2019.
engagement.judgement: Paired by the drafter: Lee 2019 does not set the monkey data beside its results. Registry checked: NCT01953497 and NCT02524678 posted no results.
engagement.quote: URC102 rapidly reduced serum uric acid, which was maintained over the entire treatment period.
engagement.note: Healthy volunteers on URC102 showed falling serum urate and dose-dependent FEUA rise, as the capuchin monkeys did.

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract read (PMID 26907620). Year 2013 is a proxy: the monkey work preceded the first phase 1 (NCT01953497, posted 2013-10-01). UR-1102 is epaminurad (URC102): the phase 2b paper cites Ahn 2016 as epaminurad's in vivo study.
efficacy.quote: These results indicate that UR-1102 achieves strong uricosuric effects by selectively inhibiting URAT1 over OAT1 and OAT3 in monkeys, and could be a novel therapeutic option for patients with gout or hyperuricemia.
efficacy.note: Plasma urate lowering in capuchin monkeys predicted serum urate lowering, the gout trials' primary endpoint.
efficacy.short: Monkey urate fall predicts sUA response

efficacy.magnitude_basis: sUA target attainment vs placebo (monkey gave plasma urate fall, no human-scaled effect)
efficacy.judgement: Paired, not stated: Jun 2025 cites Ahn 2016 in its rationale only. Phase 2a results (NCT02290210, NCT02557126) never posted to the registry or published, so they change no status. Registry checked: NCT04804111 has no posted results.

patient_trials.quote: A dose-dependent reduction in sUA level was also seen in patients with gout in two phase 2a studies (NCT02290210 and NCT02557126)

efficacy.quote: The proportion of patients with sUA < 0.36 mmol/L at week 4 was significantly higher in each epaminurad group (9 mg, 88.89%; 6 mg, 71.79%; 3 mg, 54.05%) compared with placebo (0.00%) (all p < 0.0001).
efficacy.note: Phase 2b in gout met its primary sUA <0.36 mmol/L endpoint at all three epaminurad doses, as the monkey uricosuria predicted.
efficacy.reason: Gout patients' sUA fell as predicted

added_models.model: In vitro hepatotoxicity-mechanism assays (mitochondrial toxicity, reactive metabolites) for epaminurad vs benzbromarone

safety.confidence_note: Abstract read (PMID 26907620); year 2013 proxy for pre-phase-1 work.
safety.quote: Additionally UR-1102 showed lower in vitro potential for mechanisms causing the hepatotoxicity induced by benzbromarone.
safety.note: In vitro mitochondrial-toxicity and reactive-metabolite assays predicted epaminurad would lack benzbromarone-type liver injury.

safety.magnitude_basis: liver function parameters vs placebo over 12 weeks
safety.confidence_note: Full text read (BMC open access); small, short trial.
safety.judgement: Stated comparison by the trial authors. Low confidence: 169 patients over 12 weeks cannot exclude rare idiosyncratic liver injury of the benzbromarone kind.
safety.quote: These findings provide further support to the in vitro differences observed between epaminurad and benzbromarone, with epaminurad showing lower in vitro potential for mechanisms proposed to cause the hepatotoxicity induced by benzbromarone
safety.note: No liver-function difference from placebo in the 12-week phase 2b; the authors tie this to the in vitro hepatotoxicity profile.

considered_not_added: Verinurad and epaminurad hURAT1 transfected-cell potency (Tan 2017; Ahn 2016): same system as the draft's hurat1-cell-urate-uptake track; a further member drug on that track, not a new track
Cebus monkey serum urate model for lesinurad (FDA PharmR, SR07-117): FDA judged results uninterpretable (low baseline urate, uricase present); no prediction to compare
Rat URAT1 homolog (RST-1) assay for lesinurad (FDA PharmR): rat transporter in vitro, no patient comparison distinct from the hURAT1 track
Lesinurad population PK/PD and exposure-response models (FDA ClinPharmR): built on phase 2/3 patient data after the fact; dose was chosen empirically, so not a preclinical prediction
hURAT1 knock-in hyperuricemic mouse (Cai 2025, PMID 39740040): tested only benzbromarone, a non-member
Tufted capuchin model for verinurad/lesinurad: no member-drug data found other than epaminurad
Tatrai 2021 (Pharmaceutics) in vitro Cmax/IC50 cut-off vs clinical sUA change: a retrospective analysis on the same hURAT1 cell system the draft tracks
D-0120: no preclinical model publication or patient result found in Europe PMC; not verified via press releases
Rat MSU crystal arthritis, rat/cyno tox, URAT1 LoF genetics: already tracked in the draft
